Decorated trunks were judged and the highest-rated contestants received door prizes. (U.S. Marine Corps photo by Cpl. Jason Jimenez/Released) Unit: Navy Media Content Services DVIDS Tags: Depar

title: File:Creech hosts first children's Halloween party 141025-F-YX485-035.jpg
desc: Christopher, 5, son of Capt. Scott, 867th Reconnaissance Squadron, poses for a picture during the trunk-or-treat event during the first Team Creech Children’s Halloween Party Oct. 25, 2014, on Creech Air Force Base, Nev. Activities included face painting, family photos, ring toss, pingpong, treat walk, book reading and many more. The fire department also provided a fire truck for the children to sit in and explore. (U.S. Air Force photo by Airman 1st Class Christian Clausen/Released) Unit: 432d
